component.name: TVHplayer
component.summary: A desktop client for Tvheadend for watching and recording live TV channels

description.p: TVHplayer is a desktop app for watching and recording live TV. It comes with its own built-in Tvheadend server, and also connects to any Tvheadend server you already run.

ul.li: Watch live TV and radio, with sound track, subtitle and deinterlace choices
Built-in Tvheadend server that starts and stops with the app
Scan for channels with USB, PCIe, SAT>IP and HDHomeRun tuners
Import IPTV channels from M3U playlists, with TV guide data from XMLTV
TV guide showing every channel on a timeline, with watch and record from the guide
Record on the server or on this computer, and convert recordings for video editing
Customizable channel list with logos, now and next, groups and favourites
Light and dark themes, keyboard shortcuts and screen reader support
Support for multiple Tvheadend servers over HTSP or HTTP

screenshot.caption: Channel list and player with the built-in server

description.p: A major release with its own built-in Tvheadend server.

ul.li: Built-in Tvheadend server that starts and stops with the app
Set up channels from USB, PCIe, SAT>IP and HDHomeRun tuners
Import IPTV playlists with their TV guide, and choose which channels to add
New TV guide window with watch and record from the guide
Record to this computer without a save dialog, and convert recordings for editing
Native Wayland playback with the mpv engine
Themes with a dark mode, and a new About window
Channel lists with tens of thousands of channels stay responsive
The app says why a channel will not start or stops
